svg.title: Autocomplete
svg.desc: Typing > [! in an Obsidian note opens Callout Studio's suggestion list: Abstract, Bug, Danger, Example, Failure, Idea, Info and Meeting, each with its own icon, color and IDs.

svg.text: Three things went well this week. The pilot shipped on time,
